scripts.title: Sakura Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Roam, Instant Pickup & More
scripts.features:
Auto Farm – Automatically collects leaves, deposits them, roams farming areas, and manages movement.

Nearby Collection – Automatically collects nearby leaves while managing bag capacity.

Automatic Roaming – Searches for dense leaf areas and moves between productive farming spots.

Layer Detection – Identifies productive leaf layers based on their height.

Grid Farming – Tracks farming cells, cooldowns, failed locations, and cleared areas.

Auto Deposit – Automatically deposits leaves when the bag is full or when a reset is needed.

Dumpster Selection – Detects available dumpsters and prioritizes usable deposit locations.

Zone Awareness – Selects dumpsters based on the current zone and requirements.

Stuck Recovery – Detects stalled farming and relocates to another area.

Empty Field Handling – Detects empty farming areas and waits or searches for another location.

Smooth Movement – Glides between farming locations.

Glide Speed – Adjusts the speed of smooth movement.

Direct Repositioning – Quickly repositions when smooth movement is disabled or unnecessary.

Ground Positioning – Uses ground detection to position the character safely.

Auto Buy Upgrades – Automatically purchases the cheapest affordable upgrade.

Auto Buy Bag – Automatically purchases bag upgrades.

Auto Buy Rake – Automatically purchases the Rake when affordable.

Anti-AFK – Simulates input to help prevent AFK kicks.

Live Status – Displays cash, leaves, bag capacity, farming mode, dumpster information, cash per minute, and leaves per minute.

Unload – Stops active routines, removes the interface, and clears module state.

Lobby Detection – Detects whether you're in the supported lobby or an unsupported location.

Solo Match Launcher – Automatically finds an open team square and starts a solo House match.

Match Configuration – Configures the match for one player and selects the House map.

Re-entry Guidance – Displays instructions to reload the module after entering the match.
